blocked.name: Cranial Extraction
blocked.why: Names the card, then searches target player's graveyard, hand and library for every card with it: the name is built, but no effect searches another player's library (or their hand and graveyard together) and exiles what it finds.

blocked.name: Memoricide
blocked.why: As Cranial Extraction: the search of another player's graveyard, hand and library for any number of cards with the name.

blocked.name: Slaughter Games
blocked.why: As Cranial Extraction.

blocked.name: Stain the Mind
blocked.why: As Cranial Extraction (convoke is built).

blocked.name: Lost Legacy
blocked.why: As Cranial Extraction, then that player draws a card for each card exiled from their hand.

blocked.name: Necromentia
blocked.why: As Cranial Extraction, then a Zombie for each card exiled from their hand.

blocked.name: Unmoored Ego
blocked.why: As Cranial Extraction, up to four, then a draw for each card exiled from their hand.

blocked.name: Dispossess
blocked.why: As Cranial Extraction, an artifact card name.

blocked.name: Infinite Obliteration
blocked.why: As Cranial Extraction, a creature card name.

blocked.name: The Rise of Sozin // Fire Lord Sozin
blocked.why: Chapter II names a card and searches target opponent's graveyard, hand and library for up to four with it.

blocked.name: Tamiyo, Collector of Tales
blocked.why: Her +1 (name, reveal four, the named ones to hand) is built; her static that opponents' spells and abilities can't make you discard or sacrifice isn't.

blocked.name: Runed Halo
blocked.why: "You have protection from the chosen card name": the name is built, but a player can't have protection from a quality (targeting, enchanting and damage; rule 702.16).

blocked.name: Alpine Moon
blocked.why: The name is built; opponents' lands with it losing all land types and abilities (and gaining an any-colour mana ability) is not.

blocked.name: Null Chamber
blocked.why: "You and an opponent each choose a card name": an opponent naming the second card as it enters isn't asked.

blocked.name: Mindblaze
blocked.why: Chooses a nonland card name and a number greater than 0: the number choice isn't built.

blocked.name: Blood Oath
blocked.why: Chooses a card type, not a name; nothing counts revealed hand cards of a chosen type.

blocked.name: Fertile Imagination
blocked.why: As Blood Oath.

blocked.name: Cabal Therapist
blocked.why: The reflexive name is built, but nothing makes a player discard every card with it: discard-chosen picks one, and its upTo is the controller's optional choice.

blocked.name: Medomai's Prophecy
blocked.why: Chapters I-III are expressible; IV's "look at the top card of each player's library" (a private look at other libraries) isn't.

blocked.name: Cursed Scroll
blocked.why: "Reveal a card at random from your hand": choose-random-card reaches a graveyard only.

blocked.name: Magus of the Scroll
blocked.why: As Cursed Scroll.

blocked.name: Dementia Sliver
blocked.why: Target opponent reveals a card at random from their hand: no random pick from a hand.

blocked.name: Desperate Research
blocked.why: Reveal seven, the named ones to hand and exile the rest: look-and-choose has no exile leftover.

blocked.name: Divining Witch
blocked.why: Reveal until the named card, then exile every other card revealed: reveal-until's rest has no exile (exile: true would exile the found card too).

blocked.name: Tunnel Vision
blocked.why: The found card back on top and the rest to the graveyard, or a shuffle when it isn't found: reveal-until does neither.

blocked.name: Vexing Arcanix
blocked.why: The chooser ("target player chooses a card name") is built; revealing that player's top card into their hand or graveyard, then damaging them, isn't expressible.

blocked.name: Isperia the Inscrutable
blocked.why: "That player reveals their hand. If a card with the chosen name is revealed this way": no condition counts the cards with a name in a hand.
